name: Authorized King James Version
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain in most parts of the world. However, in the United Kingdom, it is under perpetual Crown copyright.

evidence.quote: Letters patent issued by King James with no expiration date means that to print this translation in the United Kingdom or import printed copies into the UK, you need permission. [...] This royal decree has no effect outside of the UK, where this work is firmly in the Public Domain.

verification.note: Public domain outside the United Kingdom. The Crown's letters patent cover printing in, and importing printed copies into, the UK; publishing on the web from Norway is outside them.
